role: Update or remove one player's score row for an objective.
scope_reason: Vanilla creates no scoreboard objectives or teams and commands are not used, so the server's scoreboard stays empty and none of these packets is ever sent.

members.name: S3CPacketUpdateScore
members.note: the decoder's ctor only: Packet.generatePacket instantiates it by reflection (newInstance) for bytes read off a socket (MessageDeserializer); the integrated server's local channel passes packet objects with no codec (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds only the packet_handler), so it never runs

notes: Sent by ServerScoreboard's score updates (ServerScoreboard.java:35, 44, 188); addToPlayerScore's totalKillCount lookup (EntityPlayer.java:745) returns an empty collection with no objectives, so nothing is ever sent.
